entries.title: Immediate replacement of rejected or expired ID submissions
entries.summary: Tutor applicants can submit a replacement ID immediately when resubmission is requested or a submission expires, without waiting until midnight.
details: A replacement is saved before the previous submission is retired. Cleanup failures are retried without discarding the new pending submission.
The upload form and review emails explain the updated rule. Lifecycle checks covered replacement before midnight, pending status, and removal of the rejected image.
This updates the closed-test identity-review workflow; it does not issue a blockchain identity credential.

entries.title: Clearer ID-review status and outcome emails
entries.summary: Applicants see confirmation that their ID was received, can refresh their review status, and receive queued emails when staff record a review outcome.
details: The pending screen includes interview-preparation guidance and a suggested 24-48-hour review window. This is guidance, not a guaranteed response deadline.
Review emails cover acceptance, resubmission, interview matching, and other recorded outcomes. Acceptance includes the interview-booking deadline.
Failed sends are retried. Lifecycle and desktop/mobile checks used synthetic data and mocked mail delivery; inbox delivery is not guaranteed.

entries.title: Interview preparation and clearer application review
entries.summary: Tutor applicants have a dedicated interview-preparation guide, while staff can distinguish profile approval, ID review, and interview readiness in the application workspace.
details: Application review places ID status before interview scheduling, keeping document review separate from teaching approval.
The interview guide and administrator application layouts passed desktop and mobile browser checks with synthetic API responses.

entries.title: Persistent private storage for identity documents
entries.summary: Encrypted ID submissions now persist across normal API restarts when their private storage and keys remain intact, replacing the temporary memory-only testing setup.
details: Document viewing remains restricted to authorized staff. Existing deletion deadlines and retry handling remain in place.
Live checks used synthetic uploads to verify private access, fresh-process readback, and deletion. Test files and applicant records were removed afterward.
Live deletion does not guarantee erasure from historical backups or snapshots. Identity documents are not published onchain or sent to an AI provider by this workflow.

entries.title: Private tutor identity review for closed testing
entries.summary: The tutor application workflow now supports private ID submission, staff review, and a live identity comparison during the interview in a closed-test rollout.
details: The workflow separates document acceptance, interview booking, live matching, and teaching approval, with defined expiry and resubmission states.
Authorized staff can review submitted images through private application endpoints. Verification used synthetic applicants rather than real identity documents.
Identity approval is not a wallet credential. Identity-specific zero-knowledge proofs, receipt-bound issuance, revocation, and wallet recovery remain separate work.

entries.title: Transfer controls for new Engine ERC-1155 editions
entries.summary: Engine's ERC-1155 template now supports owner-controlled transfer restrictions and an irreversible transfer lock for newly deployed editions.
details: Disabled transfers apply to single and batch operations, including approved operators. A permanent lock cannot be undone through ownership changes.
Existing non-upgradeable contracts are unchanged. Creating an edition does not automatically lock transfers, verify an identity, or implement credential recovery and revocation.
Contract and API tests passed. This template deployment did not create a new onchain collection, mint credentials, or submit a proof.

entries.title: Lesson-dispute contract template in Engine
entries.summary: Engine now offers a Lesson disputes contract template with configurable administrator and operator roles, including a shared-wallet option.
details: New instances start paused, with automatic non-response actions disabled. Local contract deployment and published dashboard checks passed; browser deployment actions used fixtures.

A subsequent integration observes isolated staging events and supports a synthetic testnet pilot. Mainnet application writes remain disabled, and the new dispute workflow has not been promoted to the public apps.
The integration records application-attested events; it does not independently arbitrate lessons or transfer refunds.

entries.title: Device cleanup after a classroom closes
entries.summary: Camera and microphone changes that finish after classroom closure now release their tracks instead of leaving a late device stream active.
details: The follow-up covers both classroom roles and both supported media providers.
Live browser checks used controlled fixtures, including a device switch resolving after the room closed. This is not a substitute for a two-person lesson test across separate networks.

entries.title: Classroom preparation and an expanded first-lesson guide
entries.summary: Classrooms can prepare a private camera and microphone preview before the lesson starts, and the tutor Home guide now covers nine steps through lesson completion.
details: Device preparation requires authorized room access. The preview does not publish media before the scheduled start, and permission failures offer a device retry.
The illustrated guide now includes material selection, saving feedback, and final submission, with screenshots in both themes. It still disappears after the first taught lesson.
Tutor interview Return Home now returns to the tutor app. Classroom device lifecycle, theme contrast, and responsive guidance passed browser checks with controlled fixtures.

entries.title: Completed and cancelled lesson reminders stop appearing as unread
entries.summary: Obsolete note reminders and cancelled-session reminders now move into read history instead of continuing to count as actionable unread notifications.
details: Reconciliation runs before filtering, pagination, and unread counting. Notifications for missing lessons no longer offer unavailable action links.
Drafts and unsubmitted edits remain actionable. Regression checks covered retained history, counts, pagination, and separation between users.

entries.title: Refreshed tutor knowledge-base guidance
entries.summary: The tutor knowledge base has refreshed guidance aligned with the current tutor workflow.
details: The update was published as a scoped tutor-frontend release, with no backend changes.
Knowledge-base tests, responsive browser checks, and published-asset verification passed. The knowledge base remains available after the first-lesson Home guide disappears.

entries.title: Clearer email-confirmation arrival guidance
entries.summary: The tutor confirmation screen now explains that the email may take one to two minutes to arrive.
details: This is a copy clarification, not a measured delivery-time improvement or an inbox-arrival guarantee. The backend was unchanged.

entries.title: Lesson dispute workflow verified in private staging
entries.summary: The revised student, tutor, and staff dispute workflow has been deployed to an isolated test environment. It is not yet available in production.
details: The staged workflow includes attendance reporting after two minutes, after-lesson tutor explanation requests, 24-hour deadlines, staff review, and separate refund decisions.
Students and tutors do not exchange case messages. Tutor explanations and image evidence remain private to staff; students can follow up privately on a staff decision.

VPS checks passed for browser-origin enforcement, deadline processing, decision permissions, encrypted image upload and authorized download. Review also corrected origin checks and application-wide error responses.
Testing used synthetic cases and controlled credits with live transfers disabled. Production rollout remains gated on confirmed email delivery and a real-account classroom pilot.

entries.title: Backend typechecking passes without error exceptions
entries.summary: All 40 previously recorded TypeScript diagnostics have been resolved in the development source. These changes have not yet been deployed to production.
details: Email composition now narrows parsed image and document values explicitly, and external alert and proof-pilot JSON responses are validated before use.
Test fixtures now match Bun's fetch API and handle potentially missing array entries. The temporary known-error allowlist has been removed from the release check.
Full backend typechecking reports zero errors. Student and tutor typechecks and 50 focused regression tests passed. Paid proof submissions were not rerun as part of this work.

entries.title: A six-step guide to your first lesson
entries.summary: New tutors can follow an illustrated guide from opening schedule slots through entering the classroom.
details: Home now includes annotated screenshots for choosing times, opening slots, confirming Present, opening a booked lesson, and entering the classroom.
Classroom-entry guidance explains the five-minute entry window and camera, microphone, and pop-up permissions.
The guide automatically disappears after the first taught lesson and supports desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts.

entries.title: A more compact notification inbox
entries.summary: Tutor notifications now use a narrower layout, shorter rows, and colors aligned with the tutor workspace.
details: All and Unread filters, date grouping, and visible read and delete actions make updates easier to review.
Pagination stops when there are no more results. Failed loads and updates show errors with appropriate retry options.
Dark-mode backgrounds were corrected, including the date headings and read notification rows.

entries.title: Text chat in speaking interviews
entries.summary: Candidates and interviewers can exchange plain-text messages during the video interview.
details: Multiline messages preserve line breaks. Enter creates a new line and the Send button sends the message; file attachments are not supported.
Chat uses the interview connection, retains unsent text during reconnection, and disables sending after the interview ends.

entries.title: Clearer navigation after an interview
entries.summary: Interview rooms now have a prominent Return Home button and clearer ended-call states.
details: Leaving an active interview requires confirmation and releases the camera and microphone.
The candidate return action currently opens the student Home page. Reloading a completed interview no longer reopens camera access.

entries.title: More consistent dark-mode surfaces
entries.summary: Notification text and tutor lesson panels received targeted contrast and background fixes.
details: Student notification titles, messages, and timestamps remain readable after a notification is marked as read.
Tutor lesson-note editor attendance and assessment sections now match the modal background.
The first-lesson guide now matches the Home page background while retaining distinct controls and screenshot framing.

entries.title: Collapsed photo guidelines in Account settings
entries.summary: Profile photo guidelines now start minimized whenever Account settings opens.
details: Tutors can expand the guidelines when needed. Photo-upload and profile-editing guidance remains available in the editing flow.

entries.title: Stable schedule tab switching
entries.summary: Switching between Upcoming and Past Lessons no longer shifts the centered schedule layout.
details: Scrollbar space is reserved consistently for short empty states and longer lesson lists.

entries.title: A clearer Lesson Operations workspace
entries.summary: Administrator lesson operations now have more organized views, filters, tables, and report actions.
details: Issue-report rows were made more compact, with expandable details and evidence. Existing review permissions and refund safeguards remain in place.

entries.title: Restored analytics visibility
entries.summary: The administrator analytics page no longer gets covered by an incorrectly positioned chart fill.
details: Chart styles were scoped to prevent conflicts with other dashboard components.

entries.title: Pagination for administrator sessions
entries.summary: Administrators can browse session records in manageable pages.
details: Page controls and page-size options support desktop and mobile. Search and date-filter changes reset the current page.

entries.title: Consistent classrooms and clearer lesson panels
entries.summary: Student and tutor classrooms now share a more consistent layout, with updated chat panels, lesson notes, and recording notices.
details: Shared classroom styling keeps the two sides of a lesson visually aligned across desktop and mobile.
Lesson panels and recording notices received layout and readability improvements.

entries.title: Smoother booking setup and administrator controls
entries.summary: Booking initialization and profile booking controls were improved, with booking settings now available to administrators.
details: The student booking flow received initialization fixes and a clearer booking action on tutor profiles.
Administrator booking settings are persisted by the backend and applied to the booking policy.

entries.title: Clearer tutor profiles, qualifications, and display names
entries.summary: Tutor profiles now have improved education and qualification editing, profile guidance, and consistent public display names across discovery and administration.
details: Applicants can review profile requirements while editing their biography, photo, and qualifications.
Student-facing tutor profiles received clearer tabs, icons, and booking controls. Profile photos retain their full framing.
Public tutor nicknames are handled consistently across tutor cards, profiles, and administrator review.

entries.title: More reliable introduction video uploads and playback
entries.summary: Tutor introduction videos now have clearer upload feedback and more reliable playback in student profiles and administrator review.
details: The server measures uploaded video duration and enforces the 30-second limit, including rejection of corrupt media.
Video streaming responses were corrected to support seeking and partial-content playback.
Upload guidance, pending-video states, and profile review controls were improved.

entries.title: Clearer application progress and interview scheduling
entries.summary: Tutor application review and interview booking now have clearer progress states, more compact lists, and improved calendar handling.
details: Interview time periods and booking dates received timezone checks, with responsive calendar and appointment-state coverage.
Administrator application and interview views now make applicant progress and review actions easier to scan.
Interview waiting, feedback, and result displays received layout improvements.

entries.title: Restored social sign-in from guest booking
entries.summary: Guest booking now opens the configured student social sign-in flow, with corrected public build settings and booking initialization.
details: The deployed student build includes the public authentication configuration required by the sign-in dialog.
Guest booking and booking initialization passed browser checks.

entries.title: Readable Business English material footers
entries.summary: The Business English course label and copyright text now use a brighter color against the dark material footer.
details: The same contrast improvement was deployed to student, tutor, and administrator material views.
Desktop and mobile previews were checked after deployment.

entries.title: Authentication required across dashboard previews
entries.summary: All dashboard routes, including standalone material previews, now require an administrator session.
details: Published lesson-detail and lesson-list APIs also require a valid administrator, tutor, or student session and use private, non-cacheable responses.
Live checks covered blocked anonymous access and continued material access for authenticated users.

entries.title: Workplace Communication curriculum workspace
entries.summary: Administrators can create and edit Workplace Communication materials in a dedicated curriculum workspace.
details: Prepare and Perform material templates have their own persisted document structure.
Workplace Communication is maintained separately from the existing Business English curriculum.

entries.title: Certification checks across tutor workspace tabs
entries.summary: Profile, Performance Metrics, and Knowledge Base now require application approval, alongside scheduling, classrooms, and teaching materials.
details: Restricted navigation and direct links return applicants to their teaching journey with a Certification Required warning.
Applicants can still complete Application Profile from the teaching journey, without access to performance statistics.

entries.title: Daily Dispatch article generation restored
entries.summary: The cloud article generator is running again, scheduled for 3:00 AM Philippine time each day.
details: The worker retries failures and catches up the most recent due day after a restart.
Daily article identifiers prevent restart retries from replacing or duplicating an already generated article. The first restored publication was verified in the classroom library.

entries.title: Simpler read-aloud speaking assessment
entries.summary: New speaking assessments contain ten read-aloud sentences, replacing the previous mix of speaking tasks.
details: AI evaluation compares the submitted transcript with the assigned sentence. Pronunciation and acoustic delivery still require human review.
AI scores are provisional and do not by themselves determine the final tutor application decision.
Written exam options are shuffled before an attempt is saved, and reading-question review now checks for more plausible distractors.

entries.title: Branded tutor confirmation emails
entries.summary: Tutor application emails now include the FluentXVerse logo, a clear confirmation button, and a clickable backup link in a mobile-friendly layout.
details: The logo is embedded in the message rather than loaded from a tracking URL. A plain-text alternative is included.
Real delivery and the confirmation flow passed checks, including single-use links and resend cooldowns. Previously delivered emails remain unchanged.

entries.title: Clearer written exams and stronger question checks
entries.summary: The written exam has an updated responsive design and additional AI review before newly generated questions are published.
details: Vocabulary options must fit the sentence verbatim, including tense, agreement, and passive voice. Grammar and reading items receive structural and answer-consistency checks.
A separate reviewer call checks questions without seeing the answer key. Flagged items undergo bounded revision; the exam timer starts only after acceptance. Existing attempts are not rewritten.
Desktop and mobile checks passed in both themes, alongside a live generation, answer-saving, and resume test. AI review reduces errors but does not guarantee linguistic correctness.

entries.title: Email confirmation before tutor assessments
entries.summary: Tutor applicants must confirm their email address before accessing the written assessment.
details: Confirmation messages are sent from tutor@fluentxverse.com. Links expire after 30 minutes, work once, and are protected by resend cooldowns.
The assessment gate is enforced by the backend. Live checks covered blocked unverified access, successful confirmation, and rejection of a reused link.
Administrators can access the shared tutor application mailbox from the dashboard.

entries.title: More recognizable Engine controls and browser tabs
entries.summary: Engine now has a dedicated blue terminal favicon and a compact save control beside the proof-destination selector.
details: The save icon includes a tooltip and an accessible label, with desktop and mobile layout checks.
The favicon matches Engine's terminal mark and was checked at browser-tab sizes.

entries.title: Restored zkVerify mainnet account lookups
entries.summary: Fixed the Engine verification-account error by correcting production module imports and aligning the native RPC settings with zkVerify mainnet.
details: Production Node runtime checks now cover worker imports. The network identity check remains enforced.
Three consecutive authenticated account reads returned successfully through the public Engine service. No funds were moved or paid proofs submitted during these checks.

entries.title: Project-wide proof-receipt destination selection
entries.summary: Each Engine project can select Base, ApeChain, Arbitrum One, OP Mainnet, or Robinhood Chain as its mainnet proof-receipt destination. Verification remains on zkVerify.
details: Modules inherit their root project's selection. Existing proofs retain their original destination, and Horizen is not offered for new selections.
Approved module policies cannot be silently changed. FluentXVerse's current modules remain pinned to Base until a coordinated policy migration.
Persistence, project isolation, permissions, desktop and mobile layouts, and finalized bridge reads passed checks. A paid proof-and-relayer pilot was not run on every destination.

entries.title: Safer handling for uploads and intensive requests
entries.summary: The backend now checks access earlier and applies bounded request sizes and capacity limits to uploads and proof-related requests.
details: Unauthorized upload requests are rejected before their files are processed.
Request-protection regression checks passed on the deployed backend. These controls do not guarantee protection against every network attack.

entries.title: Session handling across student and tutor apps
entries.summary: Improved authentication handling when multiple FluentXVerse apps are open in the same browser.
details: Backend requests use the session belonging to the appropriate app rather than another app's session.
Automated checks cover mixed student, tutor and administrator sessions. A new live Google sign-in and lesson test was not part of this release check.

entries.title: Base becomes the active proof-receipt destination
entries.summary: FluentXVerse's five Engine projects now use Base mainnet. Proof verification remains on zkVerify mainnet, with official bridge receipts checked on Base.
details: Screening setup verification completed under the Base configuration. Historical transactions retain their original network.
Archived contract workflows and confidential payout settlement remain disabled. A new paid proof was not submitted as part of the migration check.
